final: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate FROM matched), pair_averages AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote), qualifying AS (SELECT p.avg_net_rate, b.avg_net_rate AS benchmark_rate FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_net_rate > b.avg_net_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS average_of_pair_average_net_fee_rates, AVG(avg_net_rate - benchmark_rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark FROM qualifying
